1.w: I say then, did God thrust away His people? Never may it be! For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

2.w: God did not thrust away His people, whom He foreknew. Or do you⁺ not know what the Scripture says in Elijah, how he pleads with God against Israel:

3.w: “Lord, they killed Your prophets, they tore down Your altars, and I alone was left, and they seek my life”?

4.w: But what does the divine answer say to him? “I left to Myself seven thousand men, who did not bow the knee to Baal.”

5.w: So then also in the present time, there has been a remnant according to the election of grace,

6.w: and if by grace, no longer out of works; otherwise grace no longer is grace.

7.w: What then? What Israel seeks after, this it did not obtain, but the elect obtained [it]. And the rest were hardened,

8.w: as it has been written: God gave “them a spirit of stupor, eyes not to see, and ears not to hear, unto this very day.”

9.w: And David says: May their table “become for a snare and for a trap, and for a stumbling block and for a retribution to them.

10.w: May their eyes be darkened not to see, and their backs bent over through all [time].”

11.w: I say then, did they stumble so that they might fall? Never may it be! But in their trespass [is] salvation to the Gentiles, so as to provoke them to jealousy.

12.w: But if their trespass [is] the riches of the world, and their failure [is] the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!

13.w: Now I speak to you⁺, the Gentiles. Therefore indeed inasmuch I am an apostle of the Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,

14.w: if somehow I will provoke my [own] flesh to jealousy and will save some of them.

15.w: For if their rejection [is] the reconciliation of the world, what [will be] the acceptance if not life out from the dead?

16.w: Now if the firstfruit [is] holy, also [is] the lump; and if the root [is] holy, also [are] the branches.

17.w: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive tree, were grafted in among them and became a fellow partaker of the fatness of the root of the olive tree,

18.w: do not boast over the branches. But if you boast over [them], you do not support the root, but the root you.

19.w: You will say, then, “Branches were broken off so that I might be grafted in.”

20.w: Rightly so: They were broken off by unbelief, but you have stood by faith. Do not be high-minded, but be afraid.

21.w: For if God did not spare the natural branches, perhaps He will not spare you.

22.w: Behold, therefore, the kindness and severity of God: severity indeed upon those having fallen, but kindness of God upon you, if you continue in the kindness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

23.w: And even those, if they do not continue in unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

24.w: For if you were cut off out of the naturally wild olive tree, and contrary to nature were grafted into a cultivated olive tree, how much more will these, the natural, be grafted into [their] own olive tree!

25.w: For I do not want you⁺ to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you⁺ may not be wise in yourselves: A hardening in part has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles may come in.

26.w: And thus all Israel will be saved, as it has been written: “The Delivering One will come out of Zion; He will remove ungodliness from Jacob.

27.w: And this [is] the covenant from Me to them, when I may take away their sins.”

28.w: For regarding the gospel, [they are] enemies on account of you⁺; but as regards election, beloved on account of the fathers.

29.w: For the gracious gifts and the calling of God [are] irrevocable.

30.w: For as you⁺ once disobeyed God, but now received mercy by the disobedience of these,

31.w: so these also now disobeyed so that through your⁺ mercy they also may now receive mercy.

32.w: For God closed up all in disobedience so that He may have mercy on all.

33.w: O, the depth of riches, both of wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable His judgments, and untraceable His ways!

34.w: “For who knew the mind of the Lord, or who became His counselor?”

35.w: Or “who first gave to Him, and it will be given back to him?”

36.w: For from Him and through Him and unto Him [are] all things. To Him [be] the glory to the ages! Amen.
